record.summary: The SPA follows the API to v2: a project switcher over the registry, the five 024 views rendered per selected project, a standby view that makes "backlog complete, daemon alive" a first-class honest state, registry controls (register, arm, disarm, requalify) with the exact-record confirmation pattern, and a global banner for daemon state and account quota. Same-origin serving, no-optimistic-UI honesty, and the unreachable-daemon degradation from 024 carry over unchanged.
record.title: Web UI v2: project switcher and the standby view
